subject: Setting up users for only viewing - not account management

messages.author: a60b0d6ac087f297
messages.subject: Setting up users for only viewing - not account management
parts:
I was curious how on shinyapps.io I can create user accounts that only allow authentication to access an apps' URL. In other words, I don't want the user to be able to view any of the actual account details. Even better, can I create users and their passwords without the system having to email that person? Eventually I see a scenario where I want to have perhaps 25 total users but it'd be great to create the accounts for them and apply the permissions by application. 

Thanks!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Setting up users for only viewing - not account management
parts:
Adding a user as an authorized user to an application (under the "Users" tab) will create a User Profile on shinyapps.io, but will not give them access to deploy or manage applications within your shinyapps.io account (logging in to the dashboard will not show the application details either). This feature is possible with the Standard plan and above. The professional plan allows you to add users to your account, giving them full access to deploy/manage/view all applications within that account, and will show the application details just as you see it for your own account).

We do have work on our backlog to allow you to do two things a) manage users via the shinyapps package.  2) send custom emails, or no emails when you add a user to an application, but it will still require them to create an shinyapps.io User Profile and set their own password or other authentication mechanism (Google/GitHub/etc).

Hope that helps.
-Andy

Hi Andy - thanks for the response but I think I'm still not entirely sure of what to do. We do have the professional plan, and I understand that each user will have to be added, but is there a way so that I can identify users who should only have access to view applications and not manage/deploy/etc? Ideally I'd have something like 25 total users, but only 2 are able to manage apps, and the remaining 23 only have the ability to view and use them. Beyond that, what about setting it up so that lets say we have 5 active apps, I can assign rights such that only 5 of the 25 users can view app 1, 10 of the 25 can view app 2, etc? Is that something that is coming along?

Thanks!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Setting up users for only viewing - not account management
parts:
Aaron,

I believe what you want is currently supported. Let me explain further:

If you visit the "Users" page under your application page in the shinyapps.io dashboard, you will be able to add users who will ONLY be able to VIEW that particular application.

If you visit the "Members" age under "Account" in the shinyapps.io dashboard, you will be able to add users who will be able VIEW and MANAGE all applications in the account.

Let me know if this is not what you are looking for.
-Andy
